# {{ site.title }}

> A kid-friendly wildlife field guide about foxes, their habitats, behavior, and how to observe them safely.

The links below lead to published website pages. Wildlife articles include
sources and image credits. Watch wild foxes from a distance; do not feed them
or treat them as pets. This file is a content guide, not a replacement for
robots.txt or a statement of permission to reuse photographs.
